newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - March 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - March 24.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Monday's Daily Variety:
* Seagram's Universal and Imagine Entertainment's "Liar Liar" grossed studio-estimated $32 million over the weekend, the biggest opening ever for a March release.
* Allen and Albert Hughes are set to direct the Jack the Ripper story "From Hell" for Time Warner's New Line Cinema.

* No matter who wins the Academy Awards, Oscar history will be made. If "The English Patient" wins, Saul Zaentz will become only the second producer to get the top prize three times. If "Shine" is named, Jane Scott will become the first solo woman to take home the trophy.
* Mexican actress Salma Hayek has landed the title role in "Frida," playing the Mexican-born artist and cultural icon Frida Kahlo for Trimark Pictures.
* Phoenix Pictures, which is developing James Jones novel "The Thin Red Line," is also in talks with News Corp's Fox to partly finance and distribute the film under the Fox 2000 banner.
